description:
Management service for the Myriad v6 broadcast software suite

Myriad Management Service v6 is the central Windows service for the Myriad v6 broadcast software suite, providing shared services such as the Remote Edit Server daemon for Myriad Playout systems.
Related Version Histories
You should also review the Myriad Playout Version History and the Support Applications Version History as many parts of the the Management Service are shared with these products. For example, any changes to the Remote Edit Server in the Support Applications will also apply to the Remote Edit Server Daemon that is included as part of the Management Service.
